name: Cosmos
use: Visual discovery, color-led searches and project collections. Start here for a Pinterest-like browsing experience.
access: Account for collecting. Offers controls to show, blur or hide images flagged as AI-generated.

name: Are.na
use: Connect images, text and links in channels; useful for concept research with written context.
access: Account for saving. Channels connect ideas; original image provenance still needs checking.

name: Raindrop.io
use: Keep source URLs organized by collection and tag, alongside your credit records.
access: Free and paid plans. Check plan requirements for preservation and advanced features.

name: Milanote
use: Arrange images, notes and links into an editorial moodboard or shoot brief.
access: Account required for boards. Check current limits before committing a large project.

name: FigJam
use: Build a shared canvas for image grouping, annotations and collaborative decisions.
access: Figma account for editing; a whiteboard rather than a fashion discovery feed.

name: PureRef
use: Arrange your own reference images on a focused desktop canvas. Recommended local option for this Linux setup.
access: Supports Windows, macOS and Linux. Provides a workspace for references rather than a source catalogue.

name: Eagle
use: Manage a large local collection with tags, folders and visual search.
access: Official downloads list Windows and macOS; no native Linux download was listed.

name: Linkwarden
use: Collect links and preserve pages; useful when the underlying article may change.
access: Hosted service or self-hosting. Login pages and dynamic media may need special handling; verify each saved page.

name: Shaarli
use: Keep a lightweight, self-hosted bookmark archive with descriptions and tags.
access: Technical setup required. A link archive rather than a polished image discovery platform.

name: FASHIONSNAP
use: Study documented street outfits, layering and brand details across Tokyo and other Japanese cities.
access: Japanese interface. Use snap dates and photographer credits when selecting references.

name: Tokyo Fashion
use: Explore Harajuku, Shibuya and Japanese subculture silhouettes through street photography.
access: Includes archival material. Check each photo’s date before describing it as a 2025–2026 trend.

name: MUSINSA Snap
use: Compare Korean daily outfits using the current Snap interface and styling categories.
access: Korean interface with dynamic content. Commercial and creator styling is not a representative population sample.

name: Vogue Korea
use: Research Korean fashion editorial direction, styling and local fashion coverage.
access: Korean-language publication. Separate editorials and celebrity looks from everyday streetwear.

name: Vogue China
use: Explore Chinese fashion editorials, designer coverage and magazine art direction.
access: Chinese-language publication. Save the specific article, date and photo credit.

name: Dewu / 得物
use: Explore a Chinese commerce-and-community platform for streetwear and outfit ideas.
access: Official site confirms a community entry point and app downloads; full community browsing was not tested.

name: Xiaohongshu / 小红书
use: Search creator styling and garment vocabulary such as 新中式穿搭 and 马面裙穿搭.
access: Retained from the original shortlist. Automated access failed; login requirements and current search features were not verified.

name: Jing Daily
use: Add reporting and market context to a China-focused visual board.
access: Some reporting is subscription content. An article’s trend claim needs its own evidence.

name: Vogue Runway
use: Compare designer collections by season, garment shape and styling.
access: Subscription prompts appear. Runway images describe collections, not everyday adoption.

name: Tagwalk
use: Research runway looks, collections and styling vocabulary; useful for comparing silhouettes.
access: Account and premium sections exist. Check feature access; reports and runway signals have a different scope from street fashion.

name: nss magazine
use: Explore fashion-week street photography, culture and editorial references.
access: Open the dated gallery, not just the feed. Coverage varies by event and city.

name: Dazed
use: Study experimental styling, youth culture and fashion editorial treatments.
access: Distinguish editorial, sponsored and documentary material.

name: SHOWstudio
use: Study fashion film, performance and illustration when developing motion or shoot direction.
access: Main site blocked automated retrieval. Official gallery page supports the fashion-film and illustration focus; playback was not tested.

name: Vestiaire Collective
use: Inspect resale listings for garment details, construction and vintage styling clues.
access: Seller descriptions and dates need cross-checking; inventory changes and photos are not a trend sample.

name: Designspiration
use: Explore visual ideas for palette, typography and photographic treatments.
access: JavaScript required; saving uses an account. Trace collected images to their original creator.

name: Behance
use: Study creative portfolios for magazine grids, branding, photography and presentation systems.
access: Official help page verified; homepage retrieval failed. Projects demonstrate an author’s design approach.

name: It’s Nice That
use: Find designer and photographer stories to inform editorial typography and visual direction.
access: Use the article’s named studio or artist as the next research step.

name: V&A Fashion
use: Research historical garment forms, construction and collection context.
access: Historical collection evidence, not a current-trend feed. Check item dates and image-use terms.

name: Europeana Textile
use: Explore textile and dress references across European cultural collections.
access: Rights and metadata vary by item and contributing institution. Use the individual record.
